title: CHAPTER ELEVEN. The same is demonstrated certainly future from the New Testament
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): We have seen such that in ye Old Testament ye resurrection belonging toward ye flesh as certainly future stands as clearly enough foreshadowed, preached, plus promised: now we shall see it taught in ye New Testament so clearly as if written by a sunbeam. || That ye same stands as certainly future stands as demonstrated out from ye New Testament. Caput ye eleventh.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER ELEVEN. That the same is certainly future is demonstrated from the New Testament.

We have seen that in the Old Testament the resurrection of the flesh as certainly future is clearly enough foreshadowed, preached, and promised: now we shall see it taught in the New Testament so clearly as if written by a sunbeam.
source_text: CAPUT UNDECIMUM. Eandem certo futuram esse, demonstratur e N.T. Vidimus Veteri Testamento clare satis adumbrari, praedicari ac promittere resurrectionem carnis certo futuram esse: nunc videbimus eam in N.T. tam perspicue doceri, ac si solis radio scripta.
